content.title: Where to Watch the 98ᵗʰ Oscars®
content.text: There’s no denying that Oscar® night is the biggest night in Hollywood, and you don’t need to be a film buff to enjoy the awards. Whether you’re planning to watch the ceremony live or catch up on nominated films beforehand, there are several ways to tune in to the Oscars® with Spectrum TV®, both at home and on-the-go. Here’s everything you need to know about when the Oscars air and how to watch them. When Are the 98th Oscars®? The Oscars® will air LIVE Sunday, March 15th 7PM ET/4PM PT on ABC and Hulu. The official red-carpet show is LIVE Sunday, March 15th 6:30e/3:30p on ABC, giving viewers a chance to see celebrity arrivals, fashion highlights and exclusive interviews before the ceremony begins. Because the Oscars® are broadcast live, it’s helpful to confirm your local channel lineup ahead of time so you’re ready when the show starts. That’s where Spectrum TV comes in. Whether you prefer watching live on your TV or streaming on a device, there are flexible ways to tune into the 2026 Oscars ceremony and nominated films. How to Watch the Oscars® Ceremony with Spectrum Spectrum offers both live TV and streaming options to watch the 98th Oscars®. If you prefer to watch live on cable, all you have to do is navigate to your local ABC channel. Spectrum TV plans include access to local broadcast channels like ABC, making it easier than ever to watch the Oscars® live as they air. To tune into the Oscars® with Spectrum TV, you have the option to watch LIVE Sunday, March 15th at 7e/4p on ABC and Hulu. Hulu is included at no extra cost with eligible Spectrum TV plans. Catch Up on Oscar®-Nominated Movies Before the Show Want to watch some of this year’s nominated films before the ceremony? Many Oscar-nominated titles are available through streaming services included at no extra cost with Spectrum TV, so you can catch up on the year’s best cinema. Below, we’ve organized several 98th Oscars® nominees by genre to help you decide what to watch first. Action and Drama If you’re drawn to powerful storytelling and character-driven performances with high-intensity action: One Battle After Another – streaming on HBO Max Sinners – streaming on HBO Max The Smashing Machine – streaming on HBO Max Sci-Fi and Horror If you prefer suspense and tension mixed with impeccable comedic timing: Weapons – streaming on HBO Max Bugonia – streaming on Peacock The Ugly Stepsister – streaming on AMC+ Family and Adventure If you enjoy imaginative storytelling and impressive animation: Elio – streaming on Disney+ Zootopia 2 – streaming on Disney+ Documentary If you’re intrigued by real-life stories and thought-provoking narratives: Armed Only with a Camera – streaming on HBO Max The Alabama Solution – streaming on HBO Max The Devil is Busy – streaming on HBO Max Watch the Oscars® Your Way The Oscars® are more than just an awards show – they’re a live cultural moment. From stunning red-carpet arrivals to emotional acceptance speeches, it’s an iconic event that cannot be missed. With Spectrum TV, you can: Watch the Oscars® LIVE on ABC and stream LIVE on Hulu Catch up on nominated films across popular streaming platforms However you choose to tune in, Spectrum TV helps make sure you stay up to date with all things Oscars.
